title: Explicit tensor, symmetry, shift and natural-comparison equations
statement: For the categorical scalar reduction and signed line data [def-pur-finite-tensor-reduction-data], define the full binary representative/counit square, the symmetry square, and the simultaneous two-shift square for a given strong monoidal comparison, using the specified scalar shift and native tensor shifts. Define the tensor/shift component as scalar shift followed by the shifted inverse binary tensorator and line comparison. The definitions are given for arbitrary monoidal shifted categories before specialization to the prescribed derived categories. Use the canonical degree-zero tensor-to-single map from [def-pur-supported-cup] to define the determining equation for any sheaf product and its derived single arrow. For a functor with a specified unit comparison, transport a line chart by the functor followed by that comparison, and define its agreement with a prescribed derived chart by equality of the entire isomorphism.
